# alacritty

Alacritty theme management: fetch the upstream theme pool and rewrite the `import` line in alacritty.toml, optionally picking day or night.

---

## `alacritty_fetch_themes`

Clone the upstream theme pool if missing, pull the latest themes, then list what is available.

**Usage**

```sh
alacritty_fetch_themes
```

**Examples**

```sh
alacritty_fetch_themes
```

**Requires** `git`

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/alacritty.sh:115`](../../modules/darwin/alacritty.sh#L115)

---

## `alacritty_is_night`

True when the local clock has passed the night threshold (ALACRITTY_NIGHT_HOUR, default 17).

**Usage**

```sh
alacritty_is_night
```

**Examples**

```sh
alacritty_is_night && echo "dark theme time"
```

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/alacritty.sh:42`](../../modules/darwin/alacritty.sh#L42)

## `alacritty_remove_themes`

Delete the local theme pool.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Recursively deletes $ALACRITTY_THEMES_DIR, including local edits.

**Usage**

```sh
alacritty_remove_themes
```

**Examples**

```sh
alacritty_remove_themes
```

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/alacritty.sh:144`](../../modules/darwin/alacritty.sh#L144)

## `alacritty_set_theme`

Point alacritty.toml at a theme from the local pool. With no argument it picks ALACRITTY_DAY_THEME or ALACRITTY_NIGHT_THEME depending on the time of day.

**Usage**

```sh
alacritty_set_theme [theme-name]
```

**Examples**

```sh
alacritty_set_theme nord
alacritty_set_theme            # time-of-day default
```

**Requires** (`gsed` or `sed`)

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/alacritty.sh:75`](../../modules/darwin/alacritty.sh#L75)

**See also** `alacritty_list_themes`

---

```

**Examples**

alacritty_setup
```

**OS** macOS only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/darwin/alacritty.sh:157`](../../modules/darwin/alacritty.sh#L157)
